svg.title: Inflammatory bowel disease decision chart: Crohn's disease (skip lesions, transmural, anywhere in the gut) split into medical disease and its stricturing or fistulizing complications, and ulcerative colitis (continuous from the rectum, mucosal) split by severity into mild to moderate and severe or fulminant disease; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

svg.text: flares and remissions · peak 20s–30s, second peak 50s–70s · rule out INFECTION first (stool tests)
